findings: Composer score verifies soprano saxophone and piano, commissioned by Brian Utley.

The 2018 North American Saxophone Alliance program lists Winter Canticles (2017), performed by Brian Utley with Melissa Rose, piano. Program remains search-index evidence because original PDF retrieval failed.
Direct composer purchase and public one-page opening preview are available.

evidence.claim: Soprano/piano, commission and actual opening notation

score_observations: Opening ad libitum pp soprano phrase has repeated fermatas and instruction that repeats should vary in length, followed by Lyrical quarter=64.
Five-sharp soprano key signature; mixed 4/4,2/4 and 1/4 bars. Slurred lines include triplets, quintuplets, rapid rising groups and large register changes over a continuously moving piano texture.
Quiet attack, flexible timing and coordination of different rhythmic subdivisions are visible. Full range and later techniques are not established by this single page.
gaps: 2017 is indexed professional-program work date; primary full source unavailable, so no public composed fill proposed.
Duration, movement divisions, edition identifiers and exact recording not verified.
